dedupe_keys.name: jersey water monthly operational data consumption reservoir storage and rainfall

description: Jersey Water, the water supplier of the island of Jersey, publishes operational data on demand for water, rainfall and water in store as documents linked from an operational data page: total monthly consumption, water in its reservoirs and rainfall. The page says the data are updated monthly and that rainfall is the average reading of 13 measuring sites. The same section describes the company's raw water storage reservoirs, treated water service reservoirs, stream abstraction points, groundwater resources, desalination plant and water treatment works. Coverage is the public water supply of Jersey. Access is online and free as documents on the company website. Caveats: the document format was not opened, and no licence is stated. Simulation uses: monthly demand and storage series for a small island supply system with storage, stream abstraction and desalination. Related records: Jamaica reservoir levels (data-nwc-jamaica-reservoir-levels) and Western Australia dam levels (data-water-corporation-wa-dam-levels-rainfall-streamflow).
